rows.grounds: indeclinable particle introducing the next topic
compound adjective describing placement in the middle of the triangle

items.question: What is the spatial relation of the two-shakti sheath to the triangle's middle?
premises: śṛṅgāṭamadhyastha places it in the triangle's middle
śaktidvayapuṭīkṛtam makes it a sheath of two shaktis
items.inference: The two-shakti sheath is situated in the middle of the triangle.
uncertainties: The exact referent of śaktidvaya is not specified by this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Then, placed in the middle of the triangle, it is made into a sheath of two shaktis.
